job.title: Project Manager - Customer Onboarding @ Customs4trade (Mechelen, VLG, BE)
job.description:
Are you a seasoned project leader who thrives on turning complex customer requirements into successful, on-time go-lives? **Customs4trade (C4T)** is looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to join our growing, cross-functional Customer Onboarding & Implementation Services team.

At C4T, we're rethinking the way companies handle customs and trade compliance—using cutting-edge technology and an agile mindset. We partner with **Fortune 500 companies** to streamline their global trade operations, and as a Project Manager, you'll own the journey from initial scoping in the sales cycle all the way through customer go-live.

Our implementations are highly consultative and complex, combining enterprise SaaS delivery with intricate customs and logistics workflows—requiring strong stakeholder management and a deep understanding of both technology and cross-border trade to drive real value for our largest customers.

 **Requirements**  

### **What You'll Own**

* Lead end-to-end implementation delivery, ensuring our large enterprise customers effectively adopt and utilize our customs management software, CAS.
* Run project kickoffs, check-ins, and alignment sessions that keep customers engaged and on track.
* Manage data-gathering and requirements sessions, working alongside an implementation consultant or customs expert when needed.
* Review customer configuration settings in CAS; dependent on project size and complexity.
* Understand customer needs and drive urgency toward key implementation milestones.
* Own central planning, maintaining clear, up-to-date project plans across your portfolio.
* Train customers to get the most out of the C4T platform.
* Establish yourself as the customer's trusted advisor and strategic partner
* Feed customer insights back internally, helping shape what we build next and identifying customer growth opportunities.

### **What makes you a great fit**

* You bring 5+ years of enterprise IT consulting or delivery experience, from a technology consulting firm or B2B SaaS company.
* You have a proven track record managing complex customer projects end-to-end.
* You're a strong communicator and presenter in English. Written and verbal—working proficiency in French/Dutch is a plus.
* You can bridge the gap between technical resources and operational resources.
* You know how to align stakeholders internally and externally and deal with project escalations
* You bring high energy and enthusiasm for logistics and Customs—or if that's new territory, the curiosity to dive into an exciting, fast-evolving market.
* You're comfortable juggling multiple projects without losing sight of the details.
* You have excellent planning and organizational skills, and know how to keep complex deliveries on track.
* You work well independently and as part of a team.
* You're eager to grow—this role is a genuine path toward a Head of Onboarding position as our Implementation Services team scales.

  
**Benefits**  

* **High-Impact Work in a Growth Environment:** Be part of a fast-scaling company where your expertise contributes directly to business success, innovation, and customer value.

* **A Globally-Minded Team:** Work together with talented professionals from diverse backgrounds and seniority levels, bringing a wide range of perspectives to drive better outcomes and make amazing things happen.
* **A Culture of Ownership and Performance:** Join a company that values initiative, clear communication, and results—within an open, supportive, and informal working culture.
* **Work–Life Integration That Supports Productivity:** We believe high performance and wellbeing go hand in hand. Our approach to work–life balance helps you stay focused, healthy, and engaged.
* **Flexible Working to Drive Efficiency:** Benefit from a hybrid working model that enables part-time remote work—designed to support both individual flexibility and team collaboration.
* **Support for Smart, Sustainable Travel:** Access a mobility budget that reimburses hybrid or fully electric vehicle use, aligning with both personal and environmental responsibility.
* **A Strategically Located Workplace:** Work from a modern, well-connected office near Mechelen train station—facilitating smooth commutes and seamless collaboration.

### **About the organisation**

At Customs4trade (C4T), we are redefining the way businesses manage global trade. Our unique team of customs and trade experts, paired with top-tier technology engineers, has created CAS—an innovative SaaS solution that streamlines and automates end-to-end customs and trade operations.

CAS empowers businesses to optimise supply chain efficiency, accelerate time to market, unlock duty savings, and gain real-time strategic insights into their global trade activities. From import/export processes and special procedures to excise management, CAS enables smarter, faster, and more cost-effective trade. Additionally, our automated solutions ensure compliance.

As we continue to grow rapidly, we’re always looking for passionate, forward-thinking talent to join us. Together, with great people, bold ideas, and pioneering technology, we’re shaping the future of global trade.

job.title: Growth & Revenue Marketeer @ Monizze (Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium)
job.description:
**About Monizze**
**Monizze**
is the Belgian challenger in employee benefits and purchasing power. We move faster than the incumbents, we test more than they do, and we're not interested in doing marketing the way it's always been done. If you want to advise on a strategy deck and hand it off, this isn't your role. If you want to build the campaign, run the experiment, read the numbers and fix what's broken, keep reading.
  
  
**Your advantages first**
Your purchasing power is optimized – the motto is true for clients & employees
  
  
30 days off per year: 20 legal holidays + 6 ADV/RTT + 4 Monidayzz
  
  
A mobility budget
  
  
Homeworking flexibility with days of remote work and a monthly allowance to make it comfy
  
  
Work from abroad up to 4 weeks a year (after 6 months @ Monizze)
  
  
Belgian roots, mindset & attitude: a cool and informal atmosphere – one of the best things since waffles
  
  
Disrupting and innovative: we digitalized the market and keep pushing innovation in every aspect
  
  
Your growth is our growth: unlimited learning opportunities (languages, personal growth, hard skills,...)
  
  
Your health and your family's health is covered by our hospitalization insurance
  
  
✨ Internal mobility is regularly an option for anyone looking to evolve or change jobs or departments
  
  
Homeworking opportunities and overall flexibility
  
  
A yearly trip with all your colleagues to celebrate our achievements
  
  
➕ We do much more for our employees, but we needed space to describe the job! We'd love to tell you about it though, so ask us!
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
You own the full customer lifecycle: from the first spark of demand, through conversion and activation, to product adoption, cross-sell and upsell. Not a single stage in isolation: the whole journey, end to end, with revenue as the scoreboard.
  
  

* Turn commercial priorities into concrete acquisition, conversion and lifecycle tactics
* Build and execute campaigns that generate qualified demand and move the pipeline
* Define audiences, angles, messages, journeys and calls to action
* Write, adapt and review campaign content: emails, nurture flows, landing pages, conversion copy,…. using AI as a daily working tool, not a novelty
* Coordinate campaign activation across paid, owned and organic channels
* Work with our external paid-media specialist to launch, monitor and optimise
* Dig into funnel and channel performance to find exactly where people drop off
* Run practical experiments across audiences, propositions, content, channels and journeys
* Team up with Sales to sharpen lead quality, follow-up and conversion
* Build onboarding, adoption, cross-sell and upsell campaigns with Product Marketing, Account Management and Customer Care
* Turn performance data into concrete next moves, not just pretty dashboards
* Bring more clarity to marketing-generated pipeline, customer acquisition cost and marketing ROI

**What This Role Holds**

* Full ownership of a campaign from first idea to measured result
* Hands-on execution: you write the brief, and you're still there when it ships
* Direct collaboration with Product Marketing, Web/Content/SEO, Marketing Automation, Creative, Partner, Sales and Account Management
* A real say in campaign angle, messaging and experimentation

**What This Role Doesn’t Hold**
This is an individual-contributor role. To be upfront about the edges of it:
  
  

* You won't manage other marketers or own a team
* You won't need to produce every visual yourself or configure every platform end to end: specialists & proper tooling will support you there
* You're not the owner of the marketing automation platform or its infrastructure. That sits with a dedicated Ops & Automation specialist you'll work closely with
* You're not setting overall marketing strategy or team structure: you execute the growth tactics within a structure someone else is responsible for prioritising and resourcing

What stays yours throughout: moving the work forward and owning the outcome, from idea to activation to result.
  
  
**How The Role Fits Into The Team**
You report to the
**Head of Marketing Operations**
, who supports you with prioritisation, planning, coordination and access to the right resources. You also work closely with specialists across Product Marketing, Web/Content/SEO, Marketing Automation, Creative, Communication, Partner, Sales and Account Management.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
You're a commercially minded, hands-on marketer who'd rather build the campaign than write the recommendation about it.
  
  
**Must-Haves**

* At least five years of experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, revenue marketing, campaign marketing and/or performance marketing.
* Experience working across both acquisition and customer lifecycle, not only lead generation
* A track record of executing campaigns that contributed to qualified pipeline, adoption or revenue
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn performance data into practical improvements
* Experience with paid acquisition, landing pages, email marketing, nurturing and conversion optimisation
* Experience collaborating with Sales, Account Management, Product and marketing specialists
* You are native in Flemish, proficient in English. The second belgian language is an advantage
* Prefer executing and testing ideas over producing recommendations that others must implement
* Take ownership from campaign brief to measurable result
* Are creative enough to develop compelling angles and analytical enough to evaluate their impact
* Can work autonomously while respecting shared priorities and processes
* Are comfortable working with imperfect data and improving things step by step
* Know when to involve specialists without losing ownership of the initiative
* Care more about customer and commercial impact than campaign output alone

**Nice-to-Haves**

* The ability to develop campaign angles and produce or improve compelling marketing copy is an advantage
* A good understanding of CRM and marketing-automation environments; experience with Salesforce and MCAE/Pardot is an advantage
* Demonstrates experience using AI to accelerate content creation, analysis, testing and campaign execution
* Experience in FinTech, HRTech, SaaS or another multi-product B2B environment is a plus.

**What Success Will Look Like**
You will help Monizze achieve:
  
  

* More qualified demand and a stronger contribution from Marketing to the funnel.
* Better-performing acquisition and lifecycle campaigns.
* Improved conversion across landing pages, nurture flows and funnel stages.
* Stronger alignment between Marketing and Sales.
* More effective onboarding, adoption, cross-sell and upsell journeys.
* A consistent rhythm of testing, learning and optimisation.
* Clearer insight into channel performance, acquisition cost and marketing impact.

**Why join Monizze?**
Real operational ownership inside an ambitious Belgian challenger.
  
  
You'll work across several markets and solutions, run your own experiments, and see the direct impact of what you build. And this all backed by a multidisciplinary marketing team and a Head of Marketing Operations who clears the obstacles so you can focus on what matters most:
*“Turn marketing opportunities into pipeline. Turn pipeline into revenue.”*
If you enjoy combining creativity, execution, data and commercial thinking and if you'd rather build the campaign than advise on it, let's talk.

job.title: Business Development Representative @ Dust (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
**About Dust**
==============

**Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.**

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. **We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.**

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

**Summary**
===========

As a Business Development Representative at Dust, you'll be instrumental in generating the qualified pipeline that fuels our rapid growth. This isn't a typical BDR role—you'll be pioneering AI-native sales development, using Dust's own platform daily to transform how prospecting and qualification work. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from 60 to 180 people, working directly with technical leaders and founders at scale-ups and enterprise companies to connect their challenges to Dust's value. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization.

**What you'll do**
==================

**Drive qualified pipeline generation**
---------------------------------------

* Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies
* Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers
* Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition

**Own the qualification and handoff process**
---------------------------------------------

* Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers
* Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps
* Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team

**Experiment and optimize the sales motion**
--------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works
* Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts
* Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates

**Be a Dust power user**
------------------------

* Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow
* Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team

**Requirements**
----------------

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

**Aptitude**
------------

* 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills
* Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage
* You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences
* Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach
* Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

**Attitude**
------------

* Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge
* Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility
* Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create
* Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude
* Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better

**Agency**
----------

* Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told
* Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end
* Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information
* Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked
* Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations

**Location**
============

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.  
  
That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

**Why Dust**
============

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

*Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.*

**Learn how we think and work.**

* Our product constitution, *a story about our mission*

job.title: Growth Lead @ Karma (Amsterdam Centrum, NH, NL)
job.description:
Are you equally as driven by connecting with people as you’re with hitting growth targets? Do you get a rush from owning numbers and building sales processes as you go? Then the role of **Growth Lead** could be it! We’re looking for you who wants to help fill Norrsken House Amsterdam with the city’s most ambitious impact founders, and with the companies that want to gather in our space.

#### **About Norrsken House Amsterdam**

In September 2026, we opened the doors to Norrsken House Amsterdam. It’s already home to 300+ change-makers who come here every day to work on solutions for a better future. But we’re not slowing down, we’re set to turn this home into a world-class co-working, club and events space that connects the entrepreneurs, investors, and partners who are set to build a future where civilization thrives within planetary boundaries.

#### **About the role**

As the **Growth Lead**, you will be the driving force behind turning our space into a vibrant hub. You’ll own the full acquisition funnel across co-working memberships, club memberships and event sales. This role gives you a ton of ownership and autonomy to impact how Norrsken House Amsterdam grows - from converting inbound leads to signed contracts to testing innovative outreach strategies and identifying the key players seeking work or event venues.

You will also influence and establish how our growth and acquisition mechanism looks by owning our sales CRM, defining targets and pinpointing key moments to optimise the funnel. You set the outreach strategy, run the pipeline, and own the monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

You’ll join our close-knit and energetic team and collaborate closely with our Community Lead, who takes new members from signed contracts to settle in, as well as our Events, Programming and Marketing team.

**This role reports to the Managing Director and is based out of Norrsken House Amsterdam.**

#### **Key responsibilities (but not limited to):**

* **Run and optimize the memberships funnel:** You’ll own the full acquisition funnel for co-working and club memberships. You’ll assess both inbound and outbound leads on our criterias to identify the startups, founders and investors who belong in our community.
* **Event sales:** Find and bring in companies, organisations and groups to book our boardrooms, club, canteen and auditorium for board meetings, offsites, conferences and more.
* **Be a great first point of contact for Norrsken:** You’ll be one of the first people potential members and guests meet with. You’ll pitch why our community exists and what makes Norrsken different. This may look like 1:1s, giving tours of our spaces, or other innovative ways to engage with potential leads. You’ll represent our mission and values confidently and ensure a great first impression for people looking to be part of our movement.
* **Own the numbers:** You’ll live in the funnel data (tours booked, applications, conversion rates, churn etc) and use the data to decide what to try next. You’ll own monthly and quarterly sales revenues across memberships and events.
* **Build our sales engine:** You’ll be the master of our sales CRM (Attio) and own the set-up and structuring of pipelines, dashboards and automations to create a smooth process.

#### **Who you are**

* **Energized by closing deals and representing Norrsken:** Outreach gives you energy. You’ll happily pick up the phone or walk up to someone at an event, and owning the growth targets and outcomes makes you feel proud and motivated.
* **Have strong communication skills and ability to engage others:** You feel comfortable engaging with different stakeholders ranging from top-founders to seasoned investors to a company looking for a space to host their event.
* **Structured and data-driven:** You keep your pipeline organized and use data to understand where you should focus your efforts.
* **Believes in progress over perfection:** You see gaps and fix them without waiting to be asked. Building something from scratch excites you and you test and try along the way instead of looking for the perfect solution.
* **Inspired by Norrsken mission and being part of a tight-knit team:** You want to put your sales skills behind the people working on the world’s biggest problems and you enjoy being part of a small team where we all roll up our sleeves.

#### **Requirements**

* 4+ years in sales, business development or similar by owning acquisition pipelines and revenue targets. Value add if you’ve worked in a fast-paced environment where requests and things move quickly such as tech hubs, co-working spaces, cultural venues, or high-end hospitality.
* Have hands-on experience managing a sales or application process in a tool like Airtable, Attio or similar. The exact tool is not so important, but we’re ideally looking for someone who has worked with a CRM before.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken. Dutch is a strong plus.

#### **Working at Norrsken**

A job at Norrsken is like working at a startup. It’s a fast-paced and exciting place to work. Tasks and challenges will be demanding, responsibilities and priorities will change and shift, but we guarantee that in return we will fast-forward your personal and professional development. And, you’ll get to work in a team of caring people with deep passion and equally high ambitions. Ten years from now, you will be proud of the projects and ideas you developed and acted on together.

We believe in radical transparency and aim to honour this in our recruitment processes. For more perspective on what it’s like to work at Norrsken, read our **Employee Value Proposition** **here** and **Culture Foundation** **here**.

#### **What we offer you**

* Gross monthly salary of EUR 4,500, with an indefinite contract.
* 25 annual vacation days as well as 8 % holiday pay.
* An additional 5 wellness days per year which are paid days off, dedicated to boost your health & wellbeing.
* Sick-leave insurance coverage (WIA & WGA) and 5 % pension contribution.
* Opportunity to invest in Norrsken funds.
* The biggest benefit of all - playing a key role in building Norrsken Amsterdam and creating a space where founders, funders, and enablers come together to learn, grow, and build a more positive future.

**We will review applications on a rolling basis so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The target start date is early January 2027.**

*At Norrsken, we are deeply committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace, as we believe it creates the best opportunity for us to meet the needs of our diverse community and guests. We actively encourage applicants from all groups and communities. Research shows that underrepresented groups, such as women and LGBTQ+ candidates, are less likely to apply unless meeting all requirements. If you’re excited about this role but are not sure you tick all the requirements, we want to hear from you.*
